title: RRB JE CBT-2 Exam Date 2026 OUT - July 2 for 2,585 Posts, Admit Card from June 28
author: Ash K.
summary: Railway Recruitment Board has announced RRB JE CBT-2 exam date as July 2, 2026 for CEN 05/2025. 39,035 candidates shortlisted from CBT-1. Admit card released June 28 on regional RRB websites. City slip available 10 days before. 2,585 vacancies for JE, DMS, CMA posts.
body: The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has officially announced the RRB JE CBT-2 Exam Date 2026 for Junior Engineer (JE), Depot Material Superintendent (DMS), and Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant (CMA) posts under CEN 05/2025. The CBT-2 exam is scheduled for July 2, 2026.

DetailInformation
CBT-2 Exam DateJuly 2, 2026
RecruitmentCEN 05/2025 - RRB JE/DMS/CMA
Total Vacancies2,585 posts
Candidates for CBT-239,035 (qualified in CBT-1)
City Intimation Slip~June 22, 2026 (10 days before exam)
Admit Card ReleaseJune 28, 2026 (4 days before exam)
Download LinkRegional RRB websites / rrbapply.gov.in
Login RequiredRegistration Number + Date of Birth
CBT-1 Exam DatesFeb 19, 20, 25, 2026 (completed)
Minimum Qualifying (Gen)40% in CBT-2 (out of 150 marks)
Minimum Qualifying (OBC/SC)30% in CBT-2
Minimum Qualifying (ST)25% in CBT-2
BiometricAadhaar-based authentication at centre

Who appears for CBT-2: A total of 39,035 candidates who qualified in RRB JE CBT-1 (held Feb 19, 20, and 25, 2026) are eligible for CBT-2. These candidates are competing for 2,585 vacancies across Junior Engineer, DMS, and CMA posts in Indian Railways.

How to download admit card: Visit your regional RRB website (e.g., rrbcdg.gov.in, rrbbhopal.gov.in, etc.) or rrbapply.gov.in → Login with Registration Number and Date of Birth → Download admit card → Print and carry to exam. Biometric authentication using Aadhaar will be required before entering the exam hall. Pre-authenticate on rrbapply.gov.in for faster entry.

What to carry: Printed admit card, valid government photo ID (Aadhaar, PAN, Driving Licence, Voter ID), and a passport-size photograph. Electronic devices, smart watches, and mobile phones are strictly prohibited inside the exam hall.

CBT-2 exam pattern: 150 questions, 150 marks, 120 minutes. Questions from Part A (General Awareness - 15 Qs), Part B (Physics & Chemistry - 15 Qs), Part C (Basics of Computers & Applications - 10 Qs), Part D (Basics of Environment & Pollution Control - 10 Qs), and Part E (Technical Abilities - 100 Qs, trade-specific). Negative marking: 1/3 mark per wrong answer.

faqs.question: When is RRB JE CBT-2 exam 2026?
faqs.answer: RRB JE CBT-2 exam 2026 is scheduled for July 2, 2026, under CEN 05/2025. The exam covers 2,585 vacancies for Junior Engineer, DMS, and CMA posts.

faqs.question: When will RRB JE CBT-2 admit card 2026 be released?
faqs.answer: RRB JE CBT-2 admit card 2026 will be released on June 28, 2026 - 4 days before the exam. The city intimation slip will be available around June 22 (10 days before). Download from your regional RRB website using Registration Number and Date of Birth.

faqs.question: How many candidates will appear for RRB JE CBT-2 2026?
faqs.answer: 39,035 candidates who qualified in CBT-1 are shortlisted for RRB JE CBT-2 2026. They are competing for 2,585 vacancies.

faqs.question: What is the minimum qualifying marks for RRB JE CBT-2?
faqs.answer: General category candidates must score at least 40%, OBC and SC candidates 30%, and ST candidates 25% in CBT-2, which is out of 150 marks.

faqs.question: What documents are needed for RRB JE CBT-2 exam?
faqs.answer: Candidates must carry printed admit card, valid government photo ID (Aadhaar/PAN/Voter ID/Driving Licence), and a passport-size photo. Aadhaar-based biometric authentication will be conducted before entry.

callout.heading: Pre-Authenticate Aadhaar Before July 2
callout.content: RRB will conduct Aadhaar-based biometric authentication at exam centres. Pre-authenticate your details at rrbapply.gov.in before the exam date to avoid delays at the centre. Carry your printed admit card - digital copies are not accepted.
